name: Repairables Anvil
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: BlockLegend001
description: Make the anvil repairable with iron ingots

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: In survival, using an iron ingot on a damaged anvil makes it chipped. With the mod turned off, the same use opens the anvil's screen and the anvil stays damaged.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Only in survival, as the mod itself does.
